verdict.rationale: The self-hosted bundle ships an admin account, per-user API keys, and a live request audit log, which covers auditing and basic identity-based access. Entity scoping separates memories by user, agent, app, and session, but that is organization, not permission enforcement. Missing for 10: role-based access control, policy or ACL definitions governing read/write per entity, evidence of access governance or audit logging on the hosted Platform, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
